title: 安全模式（Safe Mode）判定：最小副本比例阈值
expected_output:
start (0 reported) safemode_on: True
half (500) safemode_on: True
999 reported safemode_on: False
1000 reported safemode_on: False
code:
THRESHOLD = 0.999
TOTAL = 1000
def safemode(ok):
    return (ok / TOTAL) < THRESHOLD
print("start (0 reported) safemode_on:", safemode(0))
print("half (500) safemode_on:", safemode(500))
print("999 reported safemode_on:", safemode(999))
print("1000 reported safemode_on:", safemode(1000))
